items.title: Gambia’s Presidential Race Is A Toss- Up, Polls Finds Barrow Narrowly Ahead And One In Five Voters Undecided
items.summary: President Adama Barrow holds a narrow lead in a competitive three-way race, according to a new opinion poll by civil society group Gambia Participates. The poll also found that 19% of voters have not yet chosen a candidate. Asked who they would vote for if the election were he...
items.author: Fatou Touray
